description.text:
The runner-up deck of the Senior Division at the 2022 World Championships, its player's first. Sobble fills the Bench with Rapid Strike Pokémon, Drizzile, Inteleon, Octillery and Irida find the rest, and Rapid Strike Urshifu VMAX stays in the Active Spot dealing damage, while Cheryl heals all of its damage at the cost of its Energy. The 2022 World Championships were held at ExCeL London from 18 to 21 August 2022, the first in Europe and the first since 2019, after the COVID-19 pandemic put off the 2020 and 2021 events.

Pokémon sold it as one of four 2022 World Championships decks: a 60-card copy of the deck with a booklet, a pin, a coin, a deck box, a playmat, a poster and a code card for Pokémon Trading Card Game Live. Its cards have a limited-edition back, a silver border and the player's signature on the picture, and are not legal in tournaments.
